name: Channel Raw Power
description: Once per long rest, place a domain card in your vault and gain a burst of magical energy.

name: Arcane Sense
description: Sense the presence of magical people and objects within Close range.

name: No Mercy
description: Deal extra damage to marked targets.

name: Weapon Mastery
description: Gain expertise with your chosen weapon type.

name: Track
description: Follow trails and identify creatures by their signs.

name: Survivalist
description: Gain +2 to Instinct rolls when navigating or surviving in the wild.

name: Prepared
description: Take an additional domain card of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

name: Minor Illusion
description: Create a minor visual illusion no larger than yourself within Close range.

name: Rally
description: Spend 3 Hope to give an ally a Hope.

name: Performance
description: Use Presence to inspire, entertain, or manipulate crowds.

name: Cunning Action
description: Move or hide as a free action.

name: Sneak Attack
description: Deal extra damage when attacking from hiding.

name: Wild Sense
description: Sense disturbances in the natural world nearby.

name: Beastform
description: Transform into a creature of your tier or lower.

name: Prayer
description: Spend Hope to heal an ally.

name: Divine Shield
description: Protect an ally with a barrier of holy light.

name: Frontline
description: Mark an enemy to draw their attention.

name: Shield Bash
description: Knock an enemy back with your shield.
